doc.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022

title: Not feeling born too late
summary: He has no regret about when he was born and agrees the good old days are now.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Did you ever feel like you were born a little too late?

I never felt that way. Yeah I don’t regret not being around during the heyday of what they — and some people say man don’t worry about — there was never a heyday. But I don’t regret being born when I was born.
The good old days are now.
Yeah. That’s it. Now’s the time.
